sources.title: Qwen3.5-Dense (2B/4B/9B) - vLLM Ascend
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-2B, Qwen3.5-4B, and Qwen3.5-9B are dense hybrid Mamba-Transformer language models in the Qwen3.5 family. They share the same hybrid attention design (GDN + full attention) and are suitable for general-purpose text generation tasks such as dialogue, content creation, and code generation.
